notes.title: New level of gameplay! | HUGE update
notes.content:
Ciao tutti!

We have released a big update that will elevate your gameplay to a whole new level! Adding character progression with skill trees, special abilities, new cards and many QOL changes.

Let's dive in!

[previewyoutube=zlyzp7QFC9c;full][/previewyoutube]

Level Up!

First of all - let's talk about our main dish - Character Progression. This is a completely new mechanic, that will let your goons, waiters and cooks gain experience, and gain perks with each new level. You can combine several perks, or go further and unlock special abilities!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/44c79a39cb79135ed8573a7db9dae4b90d8eba52.gif

Your workers will gain XP every time they do their job. Cooks will get XP for making food, waiters for serving the clients, and goons for completing missions and winning battles against rival gangs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/7f32e18e03cdd33a8b900c82fb6e427e7aa5d55d.gif

Then, after one of your characters gain enough XP, a level-up card will get shuffled into your deck. Once you will use it - you'll see a skill tree and will be able to choose one of the options. There are quite juicy skills that you can pick, so keep these goons safe!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/c98ca73ee2ae574010b112fa2677e680a25a1259.gif

And there's more!

Here is the list of other changes and fixes present in this update

Character progression:
- Added skill trees to employees.
- Added the ability to unlock new skills when leveling up.
- Added 12 new skills for employees.

Misc:
- New patron skins.
- All dishes in the menu now divided into tiers.

Bugfixes:
- Fixed police attention gauge.
- Fixed repeated upgrade cards draw.
- Fixed VIP cards bugging after winning a fight.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/136c4bef71172d948feea7e1042e184dd97eb782.gif

Tell us your feedback!

We are really excited to hear your feedback on this update! We worked hard to implement this new mechanic, and we are thrilled to hear your feedback in the Discussions. Thank you for staying with us and keep your eyes on the news!

See you in our beautiful restaurant!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.8 | Better Call Antonio
notes.content:
Buongiorno, Famiglia!

We have just released a new update, featuring some long-awaited changes to the gameplay. Let's dive in!

Here are three biggest changes to the gameplay:

"I give up!" button.This button will finally let you quickly end the run and extract some money, skipping through the boring court. If you ended up in a tough situation - this button will definitely come in handy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/88562709cbd453915e1215ce7b5464b806f8296a.gif

Changed districts reward.From now on, all captured districts will generate daily income in black or white cash. This will help you quickly get on your feet when starting a new run in the late game. As always, central districts are the most profitable ones!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/562f0c1456bde418e0334d9a971fcc5ff46a9d03.gif

Antonio sends help.Many of our players said that they had a problem when all of their gangsters have died and made the game unplayable, as they couldn't afford to hire new gangsters. They asked: "What should i do?"

Better Call Antonio! Now, if you have no gangsters and no black cash - your fellow friend Antonio Buonelli will send you one common gangster. This will hopefully solve the issue with being stuck with no gangsters, and even if not - you also have a "I give up!" card!

A little sneak-peak into the future.Hola amigos! We saw the demand for the Spanish localization of the game. and we are happy to announce that we are actively working on adding it into the game! We expect to finish it really soon, so stay tuned!

As always, thank you for your feedback! Without it, it wouldn't be possible to release all these new updates!

Please, share your thoughts on the update in our Discussions! We read it all!
See you in the next updates!

notes.title: Update 1.0.2.6 | LOTS of changes!
notes.content:
Buongiorno, famiglia!

It's been a while since our last update, but rest assured, we've been hard at work! We've made significant changes to the gameplay, introduced quality-of-life features, and we're closing in on completing our September Fixes list.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/c0844420a035b998b7e5e0471b1edfee3abc75eb.png

But first of all, THANK YOU FOR YOUR FEEDBACK! 

We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to all our players for the invaluable feedback you've shared about the game. Your input is instrumental in our ongoing efforts to enhance the gaming experience. Thank you for being an essential part of our community!

Please, share your opinion on this update. It is critical for us to hear your feedback and improve the game even further.

Let's dive into the major changes!

Economy changes
We've revamped the in-game economy to address the previous imbalance where players had great amounts of clean cash but struggled with black cash deficits, often leading to crippling debt in pre-IOU rework builds.

The tables have turned: now all salaries and upgrades are paid in clean cash, making it less available in the early game, while black cash is now primarily for laundering, as it should be. Some cards will still consume black cash, but you won't run out of it if you stay relatively active on the streets.

Of course, we can't show you all the balance changes in one GIF, you'll have to feel them in the game yourself.

We will keep on refining the game's balance, but we will need your opinion on these changes. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/18ab577509eb3f811c350c2e7f51311cc9421632.gif

Bell indicator
We've introduced a special indicator above the deck, signaling when the next card you draw will feature a bell, eliminating the need to rely solely on luck.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/0daabd955f35bc992895aba404721fc936ba2665.gif

Boredom meter
Addressing concerns about gangster behavior, we've added a visual indicator that shows when a gangster is getting bored, helping you better manage their actions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/22552176d5732cddfc09742bf809228856bc137f.gif

Manual Battle Card activation
This feature was already integrated into the previous version. Now, you can click on a battle card to initiate combat instantly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/4c1c87864ee6c4daac232009fc8478734bf27f52.gif

Client's Order Bubbles
You can now see what your clients want to order as they approach their table, giving you clearer insight into the impact of your upgrades.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/650504dc49e9771ed23958aab80123690d73b822.gif

Tutorial Update
We've revamped the tutorial to provide new players with a better understanding of how event cards are activated and how the debt card functions. Try it out yourself!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/62db21a86b963c36555440ffc9a14d5a16d67ac3.gif

"Game Pause" Checkbox
We've included a new checkbox in the game settings called "App Pause." When disabled, the game won't pause when you switch to another window.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/d55d386715297150e803c47b3dbe4a104a5b1bb6.gif

This is a big  update and we are in dire need of feedback. Tell us what you think about it, because we won't stop refining the game until it is perfect. We do care about the game, and we care about your opinion on it.

See you in the future updates!

notes.title: Dev diary #2 | The first of its kind
notes.content:
Buon pomeriggio, signore e signori, we are Königsborgs, developers for Don Duality. Here we go with the second part of our dev diaries!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/272ea4a03fc31b8a676bd78d5aa43b9fb3d45c0f.png

About similar games in terms of setting, gameplay and visuals
We can’t say there are similar games as Don Duality. Honestly, the whole game was made on a clean slate without relying on any references. We initially thought about the experience we wanted to convey to the player - the duality of the life of a criminal, who in normal life seems to be a good citizen, but underground does dark deeds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/f40aa4fc2ab643748d69997cb79e9e21073f2d37.gif

About the challenges faced during the development
There were challenges mostly of a game design nature. Don Duality is not similar to most tycoons (we can hardly put it in this category), so we had to invent a lot of things from scratch. It was also important for us to make all the player's actions through the cards as much as possible, no other way, so it was not easy to invent.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/d4f0e731a7d718c89734a6ec7c5e48940f20f4f1.gif

Some reasons to choose the GameMaker engine
Let's start with the fact that both coders in our team know this engine well enough to write virtually any 2D game. Besides, GameMaker is quite simple, reliable and can create builds for any technological platform.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/ca1a46460010f83936106a95e40b5a2b94aa38db.gif

What movies, TV series and books inspired us to create scenes in the game
The Sopranos, The Godfather, Ozark. Interestingly enough, at the time of the first game prototype development we were watching a TV series about money laundering. Perhaps it influenced the final idea of Don Duality.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/4f1a2feb38e18ee4a0793c41ab3dd283d989a875.gif
About the created factions in the game
That was funny! Honestly, There was no plan. We just decided that the factions should be symmetrically placed in the corners of the map, so the game would be more balanced. We placed the districts themselves so that the distance between the factions would be about the same in conventional squares. So there is no magic here. Although, based on the faction archetypes, we tried to place them in areas that fit them better. I think you can easily read the factions by their appearance and name, as well as their starting locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/5805b8bfa7077ab36b80a4fe63cc54ba1f6921a5.gif

The biggest gameplay and visual changes throughout development
The biggest change is the mafia clan battle map. Although we originally planned something similar, in the initial plan we thought that there would be no other mafias on the map except for the Duality family, but in the end we came to the conclusion that initially the Duality family controlled the city and prevented other clans from taking the lead, but after the death of the father of the family, the Duality's position weakened a lot, as a result we have at the beginning of the game a state where all clans are about equal for the control of the city after a bloody war.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/9eaff1b0abc22e792102f8f9912d00ac3e154b88.gif

Grazie per your interest in our game, support and feedback! We look forward to your questions and thoughts!

notes.title: Dev Diary #1 | The duality of gamedev
notes.content:
Hello friends, 

we are Königsborgs, Don Duality devs. We would like to tell you about our game, its development and a bit about us! 

The team was formed spontaneously, during a jam, and includes the main programmer, who isn't even a gamemaker at all, the artist, the animator (he is only 15 years old!), the composer and, finally, the game designer. The game designer links the team together and, besides game design, he also deals with code and a bit of special effects. We can say that all of us in the team are self-taught.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/6f9d5a0764062280d69a68921493c23b3828bb30.png

And now, about our brainchild - Don Duality! The idea for the game came right on the first day of the jam, as it usually happens. The concept of making a tycoon with mafia money laundering through a restaurant belonged to the main programmer of the project, and the game designer just added the card interaction mechanics. In two days we made a playable prototype and posted it on the jam site, but then completely forgot about it for a month.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/379823b3924fd51f4ea01227b5aa0c62399fb3cb.png
One of the WIPs.

After a while we remembered Don Duality and the Indie Cup festival, where in the end we decided to upload the improved version and even made the game trailer out of whatever we could. After a while our team started to receive cooperation offers, and the game was signed by the publisher Ravenage. 

The idea of the game is totally innovative. How can we describe Don Duality? Originality. Addictiveness. Simple controls. As they say, easy to learn - hard to master.

The main difficulty is managing the balance. We're working on it all the time, and it's still not perfect. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43365106/05eedf65c8da58540d35ce47387198a5a1882e45.png
The way the game looks now.

The setting was born from the game's theme of "duality." So, the title occurred literally as soon as we thought about the mafia and the restaurant. The Italian trace is more of a popular trope associated with the image of the Mafia. There is no direct inspiration for the game, although it is the mechanics with events that we took from the board game Hunted. Some of the events will have references to the real ones or from the movies.  I dare say that Don Duality is a new genre that combines a card game, management, and strategy.

This is Mike, your faithful consigliere and I come to you with good news!
Don Duality, the tycoon game with card mechanics, is looking for beta testers.

Well, well, well, look who we have here. It's your loyal consigliere, Mike. I come bearing good news, eh? Don Duality, the tycoon game with card mechanics, is on the hunt for beta testers. You know what that means, don't you? It's time to make our mark and show the world what we're made of. We need our best men on this one, so round up the crew and let's get this job done.

We've been hard at work since the demo, and we're excited to announce some major updates to Don Duality! In addition to refining the gameplay mechanics and balancing the difficulty, we've added new features like expanded customization options for your gangsters and restaurant staff. We've also incorporated player feedback to improve the user interface and overall user experience. With these updates, we're confident that Don Duality will provide even more engaging gameplay and immersive storytelling than before. 

Step into the shoes of a Don, manage your empire and navigate the delicate balance between running a successful restaurant and operating a thriving mafia.

How to participate in the Closed Beta Testing?

 Kindly leave a comment beneath this announcement indicating your intent to participate in the closed beta testing.
 Please extend a friend request to me and initiate conversation with the following message: "Greetings, I am participating in the closed beta for Don Duality."
 Upon accepting your friend request, you will receive a unique Steam key granting access to the Closed Beta.
Any feedback would be much appreciated!

Don't miss out on the opportunity to build your empire and rule the criminal underworld.
